whyTrulab.title: Fewer vendors to brief. One look everywhere you post.
whyTrulab.description: When one vendor films, another edits and a third designs, you brief three times, chase three people, and your brand looks different on every channel. {company} plans, shoots, edits and delivers it all, so you deal with one team.
points: One team for podcasts, video, photography, design, websites, marketing and branding.
No studio needed. We bring the crew and kit to your office, venue or event, anywhere in Malaysia.
One recording becomes many posts: a full episode plus short clips for your social channels.
Colour graded, subtitled and finished with a custom thumbnail, ready to publish.
Producing every week or month? A monthly partnership keeps your podcast, clips, photos and social posts coming.
Registered with MOF and recognised by FINAS and FDAM, ready for government and corporate procurement.

process.title: A clear process from first conversation to final delivery.

items.title: Consultation
items.description: A free consultation to understand what you want to produce, who it is for, your budget and your deadline.

items.title: Planning
items.description: We agree the concept, script or talking points, shoot date, location and equipment before anything is filmed.

items.title: Production
items.description: We set up and record on the agreed date, at your location or one we arrange.

items.title: Editing
items.description: We edit, colour grade, add subtitles and retouch until every piece looks and sounds right.

items.title: Delivery
items.description: You receive final files in the right format for each platform, ready to publish.

items.title: Growth
items.description: We turn the best moments into short clips and posts, and can manage your social media and ads to keep you visible.

certifications.title: Registered with MOF and recognised by FINAS and FDAM.

coverage.title: We bring the studio to you.
paragraphs: Kuala Lumpur, Selangor, Putrajaya, Johor, Penang, Sabah, Sarawak or anywhere else in Malaysia: {company} brings the cameras, lights, microphones and crew to your office, venue or event. You do not need to book a studio.
Producing every week or every month? A monthly partnership keeps your episodes, clips, photos and social posts coming from one team.

contact.title: Tell us what you want to make. We will plan it with you.
contact.description: Use the form or message us on WhatsApp. Tell us what you want to produce, who it is for and when you need it. {company} will recommend the right setup and send you a quote.

footer.description: {company} is a creative production studio in Malaysia. We film video podcasts on location anywhere in Malaysia, plus video, photography, design, websites, marketing and branding.
